name: desktop_actuator
description: Direct Hardware Desktop Vision-Action Actuator. Interacts with flowork-sysd for zero-copy DRM screen capture and evdev/uinput virtual hardware input injection with high-speed macro action sequences, continuous brush drag paths, and hotkeys.

sequence.description: High-speed macro action sequence. Array of action objects executed natively in one turn at kernel hardware speed.

via.description: Continuous coordinate path for fluid vector drawing/brush strokes/drag.

step_delay_ms.description: Delay in ms between via points during drag/brushing (default: 5).

keycodes.description: Array of evdev keycodes to press in sequence and release in reverse order (e.g. [29, 31] for Ctrl+S).

text.description: Text payload to type at microsecond hardware speed.

delta.description: Mouse wheel scroll delta (negative for down, positive for up).

dx.description: Relative X displacement for mouse movement.

dy.description: Relative Y displacement for mouse movement.

interval_ms.description: Interval between multiple clicks in ms (default: 20).

keycode.description: Linux evdev/uinput keycode (e.g. 28 for Enter, 1 for Escape).
